scope: Native macOS direct-mail MX lookup dependency only; owned DNS-SD service, bounded waits, cancellation and standalone record decoding. No direct SMTP submission or application routing.

upstream_evidence.behavior: SendSpeedEmail groups To/CC by mail domain, calls DnsQuery(MX), and tries returned exchanges on port 25. This checkpoint replaces the DNS dependency, preserving returned record order.

MX.coverage: Big-endian preference, hostname/null MX, malformed/truncated/compressed/trailing/embedded NUL/label-length records, valid 253 and rejected 254 hostname lengths, invalid domains/timeouts, pre-cancel; actual system read-only Gmail MX query, 32 post-open cancellations with unchanged descriptor count.

first_link_failure.finding: SDK has no standalone libdns_sd. DNS-SD is re-exported by libSystem, confirmed from the local SDK .tbd. Extra linker dependency removed from package/project and regenerated project; those files match parent. First failure log preserved.

SDK_native.coverage: Actual built Core/SMTP frameworks pre-cancel and read-only system MX query returned five records; existing owned loopback SMTP exact MIME, distinct To/CC and binary attachment decoder checks passed. No SMTP connection to queried domain.

checks.inventory: Pinned inventory regression passed; HwSMTP rows remain partial with explicit direct-submission backlog.
checks.cleanup: No matching app/test/compiler/SMTP/helper processes or current fixtures. DNS service references are freed by lookup; live cancellation test checked descriptor count across 32 opened/cancelled services. No user credentials/preferences were read or written by the DNS probe.

limitations: The complete SwiftPM suite was not rerun after this Core change; 27 focused cases passed, with the 22 mail cases repeated for both Git runtimes. Public DNS results are observed responses, not fixed future assertions; default CI skips the opt-in public query. No direct-delivery grouping/envelope/MX-failover/partial-acceptance queue or app route exists yet. No actual direct mail, Keychain, main app, displayed UI, signed sandbox/Finder or distribution verification. The full port remains unfinished.
